## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
Sector Rotation / Transitional market, not outright Risk-Off; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: weak overall breadth (4/11) and Financials + Industrials net negative, but MAJOR divergence across large caps; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads: TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND, GM (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +2.02% | 1M: +15.07%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing strength via EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND. Communication strength concentrated in META (1W: +3.22% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND. Energy weak: VLO (1W: -3.78% | 1M: -9.63%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -1.92% | 1M: -0.69%) BELOW TREND. Industrials showing fatigue: CAT (1W: -5.36% | 1M: +2.30%) CORRECTION.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND; TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND; COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND; GM (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +19.73%) ABOVE TREND; BMY (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +16.47%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND; NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND; AVGO (1W: -8.35% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND; AMD (1W: -4.61% | 1M: -10.06%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Top 1W movers: TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND; EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND; META (1W: +3.22% | 1M: +12.65%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence flagged: multiple large caps (AAPL, MSFT, JPM, V/MA) show opposing 1W vs 1M signals — treat regime calls as tactical, not definitive.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is under pressure with concentrated weakness; NVDA (1W: -0.50% | 1M: -6.63%) BELOW TREND, AVGO (1W: -8.35% | 1M: -6.92%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: weak (Technology underperforming on 1W); positioning should be selective.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed to flat on 1W but pockets of strength persist: COF (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +19.96%) ABOVE TREND, USB (1W: +0.84% | 1M: +15.11%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -1.73% | 1M: +3.21%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Financials showing uneven internals despite some leaders.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare mixed with selective winners: BMY (1W: +1.76% | 1M: +16.47%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.86% | 1M: +0.69%) ABOVE TREND, AMGN (1W: +2.10% | 1M: -4.58%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: middling; defensive tone not dominant.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to selective cyclicals and financials showing confirmed momentum (TSLA, COF, USB) and reduce exposure to weak mega-cap tech names (NOW, ORCL, AMD) until trend recovery is confirmed; style mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND; EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: NOW (1W: -11.35% | 1M: -6.07%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -5.23% | 1M: -20.17%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (visible leadership from TSLA, GM; sector 1W positive). BEARISH: Technology and Energy (both showing concentrated 1W weakness).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA for failure to reclaim recent 1M support structure (continued BELOW TREND would widen tech weakness). Monitor AAPL (1W: -2.19% | 1M: +1.35%) CORRECTION for confirmation of a trend break or bounce. TSLA momentum continuation above this week’s highs would reinforce cyclical leadership.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Sector Rotation / Transitional market with caution; Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5). TSLA (1W: +8.16% | 1M: +20.47%) ABOVE TREND and EL (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +26.11%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is the MAJOR divergence among large caps (AAPL, MSFT, JPM vs. leaders) — watch for trend confirmation before enlarging positions.
